credit_metrics.text: EBITDA increased by {{ebitda.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda@FY2024}} on revenue up {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}}, but operating profit fell by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}} as depreciation, amortisation and impairment were stable at {{dda@FY2024}} and finance costs declined by {{finance_costs.change@FY2024}} to {{finance_costs@FY2024}}.

Interest coverage improved to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}} as finance costs fell, and FFO was stable at {{ffo@FY2024}}, leaving FFO to debt broadly unchanged at {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}}.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue down by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.
The group issued a bond in May 2024, whose proceeds are reported among the year's cash flows alongside operating cash flow of {{cfo@FY2024}}.
Total debt rose by {{total_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{total_debt@FY2024}}, so the cash buffer covers a smaller share of the debt stock than a year earlier.

operating_performance.text: The Paris airports handled {{passengers@FY2024}} passengers in FY2024.
Group revenue rose by {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}}, with the October 2024 acquisitions of Paris Experience Group and P/S extending the Extime offering beyond the Paris airports.
Capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}, reflecting the investment programme across the airport network.
DIAL filed its tariff proposal for the next regulatory period in May 2024, with final tariffs published in March 2025 and effective from April 2025.
